name: Vmessage
description: Vmessage 1.6.2 patched: (1) Component.replaceText(String,ComponentLike) -> TextReplacementConfig (Velocity 4.x / adventure compat); (2) [Custom-Meta] supports unlimited placeholder -> LuckPerms meta key entries instead of only custom1/custom2; (3) any #xxx# in the format is resolved as a LuckPerms meta key directly; (4) optional PAPIProxyBridge support: %placeholder% in the format is resolved by the player's backend server
